source_cards.back: All riders in belt-equipped passenger vehicles, pickups, SUVs, and trucks must buckle up, and children under eight need approved car seats unless past four feet nine inches, since belts prevent ejection, dashboard strikes, and lost control.

source_cards.front: May children under eighteen ride in an open truck bed, and what defenses exist?
source_cards.back: Children under eighteen may not ride in open truck or trailer beds, though parades, emergencies, rural farm-worker shuttles, beaches, sole household vehicles, and permitted hayrides defend the charge.

source_cards.front: What must cars and light trucks use when towing a trailer?
source_cards.back: Cars and light trucks towing trailers must hitch DPS-approved safety chains, excepting farm trailers and federally compliant rigs.
